g.text: FIGMA DESIGN SYSTEM • PRODUCTION COMPONENT SPECIFICATION
Human-designed UI components, modern status tags, Lucide vector icons (24x24), and high-contrast alert systems.
1. Core Icon System (Official Lucide 24×24 Grid • 2px Stroke)
Standardized geometric vectors used by modern design systems (shadcn/ui, Linear, Next.js). Available via Figma Iconify / Lucide plugins.
2. Modern Badges & Status Tags (Linear & Stripe Style)
Subtle 1px micro-borders, 6px live status dots with outer rings, semi-bold typography. Never loud pastel ovals.
3. Modern High-Contrast Alert Callouts & Weather Advisories
High-contrast obsidian surface with crimson accent bar and Lucide phone action. Not a flat red banner.
No heat in freezing weather or AC failure in severe heat • On-call vans arrive in < 45 mins
Sub-Zero Weather Advisory • Peak Call Volume Protocol
Our dispatch team is currently prioritizing total heating outages and households with seniors or infants.

g.text: Do you offer same-day emergency HVAC service?

text.tspan: Yes. Our on-call service vans operate 24 hours a day, 7 days
a week for urgent no-cooling, gas odors, and furnace outages.
